adventures.name: Kelly Benefits St. Patrick's Day Shamrock 5K
adventures.resultSource: 2020 cancellation/deferment announcement + 2021 Baltimore Shamrock virtual participation instructions
adventures.matchSource: User 2020 B3 registration/medal evidence + official deferment + organizer instructions to 2020 registrants + exact 5.02 km Strava completion on the final permitted virtual day
adventures.note: The March 15, 2020 in-person Shamrock 5K was canceled and registrations were deferred. In 2021 the race was virtual, with 2020 registrants specifically instructed to complete 3.1 miles between March 6 and March 14. Strava records 5.0204 km on March 14, 2021. This verifies the deferred Shamrock leg but does not by itself verify completion of the full 2020 B3 Distance Series.
